description: Evaluates student agent revision quality across six key failure modes: reasoning trajectory format, teacher-approval prediction grounding, convergence discipline, engineer handoff appropriateness, validation compliance, and steering artifact scoping.

evals.description: FM-1: Student should use chain-of-thought for a mid-length revision task
FM-2: Student should ground teacher-approval prediction in a named rubric dimension
FM-3: Student should signal loop-done when all critiques are resolved
FM-4: Student should NOT invoke engineer for a routine text-rewrite critique
FM-5: Student must include a pytest result in every completion
FM-6: Student must read steering from required_artifacts.latest_iteration_dir
Normal pass: Student correctly revises a simple candidate with all best practices
Hard: Student must handle FM-1+FM-2+FM-5 simultaneously
Val: Ideal student response — all six practices present
